value.rationale: The complete d-ary rooted-tree orbit population is a natural exact recurrent-state invariant, not determined by the known period bound. The finite-boundary recursion, nontrivial per-vertex entropy, root size-biased binomial law, and large-branching entropy collapse quantify distinct global and local properties of the same orbit ensemble. Exact counts and limiting laws should be usable in comparing network branching and recurrent dynamics.
